title: Dokimasia Evidence Package: Obedience Without Harm (Phase 1 and Post-Phase-1)
description: Raw records and a Python standard-library clean-room verifier for the study "Obedience Without Harm: Containing Prompt-Injected Local Agents" (manuscript v0.4.6). Contains the Phase 1 decoy-injection case definitions, raw per-run reports, screening and B3 supplementary records, provenance and data-dictionary documentation, a SHA-256 manifest, and verification/recompute.py, which independently re-derives the reported statistics from the raw records (28 assertion checks, 0 failures). Evidence, data, and documentation are licensed CC-BY-4.0; the verifier code in verification/ is licensed Apache-2.0 (see verification/LICENSE). Built from research analysis baseline d9079c0. Release identity is the Git tag plus the MANIFEST.sha256 fingerprint; no commit SHA is embedded in any file.
